title: Concentration of the hypergraph's weak independence number
comment: Update after journal review, simplification of one of the lemmas
abstract: In this note we generalize the results of the recent work by Tom Bohman and Jacob Hofstad on the independence number in G(n, p) to the case of the random k-uniform hypergraph. Concentration in two values occurs in the regime $p>n^{-(k-1)k/(k+1)+\varepsilon}$.
